newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek industrial output up 1.4 pct yr/yr in June.
newsitem.headline: Greek industrial output up 1.4 pct yr/yr in June.

text.p: Greece's industrial production and manufacturing output rose a provisional 1.4 percent year-on-year and 0.3 percent, respectively, in June after rising 3.2 percent and 2.3 percent year-on-year in May, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said.
The increase in June industrial production was mainly due to a rise of 11.6 percent year-on-year in mining output and 2.3 percent in electricity-gaslight, it said.
